job.title: Paid Search & Youtube Manager
job.description:
About the Job
Mars Men is one of the fastest growing DTC brands in the US, achieving $100M run rate in less then 18 months. Recently backed by L Catterton, Mars Men is positioned to become the leading men’s health brand in the supplement space. We operate across DTC, retail, and emerging channels, and are entering our next phase of growth as we continue scaling the business.

We’re looking for an exceptional Paid Search & YouTube Manager to help scale Mars Men’s next stage of growth. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, driving efficient customer acquisition while growing revenue and acquisition volume.
You’ll work closely with our Growth, Creative, and Analytics teams to translate business goals into campaign strategy, build a structured testing roadmap, and continuously improve performance. This is a role for a highly analytical, hands-on performance marketer who takes ownership of channel results, knows how to turn data into action, and thrives in a fast-moving environment where their work has a direct impact on the business.

- Own and scale the day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, deploying budgets effectively to hit CPA, acquisition volume, and revenue targets while identifying opportunities to scale efficiently.

- Develop and execute campaign strategies aligned with business goals across keyword targeting, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, campaign structure, and budget allocation.

- Build and lead a structured testing roadmap across ad copy, creative, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies, using performance insights to continuously improve results.

- Analyze and optimize full-funnel performance to identify trends, diagnose account inefficiencies, investigate fluctuations in results, and uncover opportunities to improve conversion rates and drive profitable growth.

- Strengthen measurement and attribution by optimizing conversion tracking, improving signal quality, and partnering with Analytics to ensure accurate reporting and effective performance-based bidding.

- Collaborate and stay ahead by working closely with Growth and Creative on campaign performance and funnel efficiency while keeping up with changes in search, paid media, and AI-driven advertising.

- 3–5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally at a fast-growing DTC, eCommerce, subscription, or consumer brand, with a track record of improving performance and scaling acquisition.

- Deep expertise in paid search and Google Ads, with the ability to independently build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns and translate business objectives into effective channel strategy. Experience with YouTube Ads is strongly preferred.

- Proven ability to own performance against CPA and ROAS targets, balancing acquisition volume, revenue growth, and efficiency while making sound decisions about when and where to scale spend.

- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience using GA4, Northbeam, or similar analytics and attribution tools.

- A deep understanding of conversion tracking and measurement, including attribution, conversion signals, and performance-based bidding, with the ability to identify data quality issues and turn insights into actionable improvements.

- A strong bias toward ownership and action, with the ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and move work forward in a fast-paced startup environment.

 Life at Mars Men
Competitive Compensation - We offer a strong salary and benefits package, tailored to attract top talent
Remote Work Environment - Our team is remote, offering full flexibility to work from home
Autonomy & Ownership - You’ll have the freedom to run your own systems and make real impact
Time Off - 15 PTO days per year (prorated), 9 company holidays, plus your birthday off
Parental Leave - Generous paid parental leave for growing families
Health Benefits - 100% premium coverage for health, dental, and vision plans, with 25% coverage for dependents
401(k) - Company-sponsored plan with a 2% match through Guideline (elective participation)
$200 Annual Superpower Membership
Growth & Development - We invest in your professional development with ongoing learning opportunities

job.title: AI Marketing Strategist (PST based)
job.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby 2 — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You're Applying for

Triple Whale is looking for a Context Engineer to help ecommerce brands successfully adopt Moby, our AI teammate for marketing analysis, planning, and execution.

This is a customer-facing activation role for someone with strong performance marketing instincts, practical AI fluency, and the ability to help customers turn Moby into a trusted part of how they work. You will not be the long-term operator inside the customer’s business. Your job is to enable the customer’s own operators - founders, marketers, agencies, and growth teams to use Moby confidently and effectively.

*This is a remote role with a strong preference for candidates based on the West Coast. The person in this role must be able to consistently work Pacific Time (PT) hours.*

What You’ll Do 

  • Lead customer activation for Moby, helping new users identify the first use cases most likely to create value.
  • Translate each customer’s goals, team structure, marketing motion, and growth challenges into practical Moby workflows.
  • Enable customer operators to use Moby in their day-to-day work across paid media, measurement, creative, and growth planning.
  • Coach customers on how to evaluate Moby’s recommendations, ask better questions, and turn AI outputs into decisions.
  • Be prescriptive during onboarding: diagnose opportunities, recommend workflows, and help customers build early trust in Moby.
  • Maintain strategic relationships with customers to help them discover and adopt new Moby use cases over time.
  • Identify repeatable activation patterns and turn them into playbooks the broader team can use.
  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to share customer feedback and improve the Moby experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on experience in media buying, growth marketing, ecommerce marketing, or agency strategy.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, Klaviyo, or similar ecommerce/growth tools.
  • Strong understanding of marketing metrics like CAC, ROAS, MER, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, retention, and payback.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, n8n, or similar systems.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with founders, marketers, operators, and agencies.
  • The confidence to be prescriptive without taking over: you can recommend what to do while teaching the customer how to operate.
  • Curiosity, speed, and a collaborative attitude in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bonus: 
    • Agency experience or experience managing multiple brands/accounts.
    • Experience scaling DTC or retail brands.
    • Familiarity with attribution, incrementality, MMM, or marketing measurement.
    • Comfort with SQL or BI tools.
    • Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or performance marketing leadership.

The expected base salary for this role is $120,000–$150,000 per year.

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

job.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
job.description:
As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients.  The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale. 
In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

- Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.

- Ongoing optimization of live user workflows and capabilities including monitoring of key metrics & user feedback

- Work with internal teams and end users to develop a deep understanding of requirements, perform thoughtful solution design, use data to test hypotheses, and support teams throughout execution.

- Write detailed user stories for new features, capturing detailed descriptions of business rationale, requirements, and success criteria that are defined by measurable outcomes.

- Develop short- and long-term roadmaps that deliver maximum value with minimum risk and assume ongoing iteration.

- 5+ years of product management experience in marketing technology, technology-enabled services industry, or a SaaS product.

- Experience using data and primary research to inform solution design and build internal business understanding.

- Experience with and understanding of the software development lifecycle and software development methodologies.  Preferably experience with Agile / Scrum teams.

- Product development experience in the context of the development of a healthcare technology product.

- Strong product-oriented martech domain expertise, with a clear understanding of how marketing and sales platforms, data and processes work together to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- Broad knowledge of the martech landscape (e.g. CDP, DAM, CMS, Marketing automation, etc.), including how unified data enables personalization and agentic marketing.

- Experience identifying and deploying high-impact AI and agentic marketing use cases that drive pipeline growth and operational efficiency.

- Experience working on or owning platforms in the marketing technology space (eg Hubspot, Salesforce, Seismic, Gong, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, etc).

- Knowledge of Salesforce CRM capabilities and constraints, including its standard objects, data model and processes.

- Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs), identity resolution and consent and preference management. Working knowledge of SQL.

- Track record of delivering practical martech solutions that improve marketing and sales effectiveness, from process and data improvements to new platform capabilities and integrations.

- Comfortable working in ambiguity and with competing stakeholder needs, bringing structure to complex problems and driving alignment on the right solution.

- Excellent organizational and communication skills with an emphasis on problem-solving and building subject matter expertise.

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

 Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
 
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

job.title: SEO and Content Marketing Strategist - Contract
job.description:
About Digital Reach Agency:

Digital Reach Agency is a leading B2B digital marketing agency specializing in SaaS and tech industry clients. We empower businesses by aligning their brand, connecting systems, and generating pipeline through comprehensive audits and strategic marketing initiatives. We’re a fully remote company with a dynamic team that values autonomy, communication, and collaboration.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SEO and Content Marketing Strategist to join our team. This contract role requires a dual focus on developing and executing advanced SEO strategies while supporting content marketing initiatives for B2B and enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of SEO best practices, be highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing complex SEO projects from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Content Strategy & Development:

- Work closely with the content team to align SEO objectives with content strategy, ensuring that content is optimized for both search engines and user experience.

- Develop and execute content strategies for websites, landing pages, and other digital assets, focusing on SEO-driven content that aligns with client goals.

- Utilize Voice of Customer (VoC) insights and keyword research to inform content creation, ensuring that messaging resonates with target personas.

- Conduct content audits to identify gaps and opportunities, recommending improvements to boost organic search visibility.

- Optimize existing content for SEO, ensuring that all digital assets adhere to the latest SEO guidelines and best practices.

- SEO Strategy & Execution:

- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive SEO strategies tailored to the specific needs of B2B clients, with an emphasis on increasing organic traffic and improving search engine rankings.

- Perform in-depth keyword research, focusing on high-intent keywords that drive qualified traffic and conversions.

- Conduct technical SEO audits, identifying and resolving issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexing.

- Optimize on-page elements, including meta tags, headers, content, and internal linking structures, to enhance SEO performance.

- Collaborate with the development team to ensure that SEO best practices are followed during website updates and redesigns.

- Drive off-page SEO strategies, including link building, outreach, and digital PR, to enhance domain authority and backlink profiles.

- Analyze competitors' SEO strategies to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.

- Client Management & Reporting:

- Lead client calls, presenting SEO performance reports, discussing strategic initiatives, and managing expectations effectively.

- Prepare and deliver detailed SEO reports, including analysis of traffic, rankings, conversions, and other key metrics.

- Provide clients with actionable insights and recommendations based on data-driven analysis, helping them achieve their digital marketing objectives.

- Continuous Improvement & Collaboration:

- Stay updated on the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and industry developments, continuously refining strategies to maintain and improve performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including web developers, designers, and content creators, to deliver cohesive and impactful digital marketing campaigns.

- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and team development by staying abreast of emerging SEO tools and techniques.

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in SEO, with a strong focus on B2B campaigns.

- Proven experience in content strategy development, particularly for websites, landing pages, and digital marketing assets.

- Deep understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and link building.

- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, and other related platforms.

- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to lead client calls and manage expectations effectively.

- Experience in the B2B, SaaS, or tech industry.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to work autonomously in a remote environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines.

- Experience with content management systems and project management software (e.g., Asana).

Major Pluses:

- Previous experience at a digital marketing agency.

- Proven track record with case studies or a personal portfolio of successful SEO and content strategy work.

- Experience with WordPress development, marketing automation, and CRMs.

- Knowledge of cross-domain strategies (CRO, UI/UX, Paid Media, etc.).

- Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and time-tracking software.

- Familiarity with GIF-based communication (we love a good GIF!).

Benefits

Location: Remote

Position: Contract

Salary: $40 - 50/ hour

job.title: Director, Newsletter & Email Marketing
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Newsletter & Email Marketing based in the United States.

We are seeking a hands-on email marketing leader to oversee and scale a high-volume, revenue-generating newsletter program serving audiences across 22 markets. In this role, you will drive newsletter strategy, campaign execution, audience engagement, deliverability, and commercial performance while protecting the subscriber experience. You will manage more than 40 campaigns per week alongside automated lifecycle journeys, sponsored placements, and targeted product marketing initiatives. Working closely with marketing leadership, advertising sales, merchant partners, and analytics teams, you will turn campaign data into actionable insights that strengthen monetization and long-term audience value. As a player-coach, you will combine strategic direction with hands-on execution, technical expertise, and team development. This is an opportunity to shape a global email marketing operation, improve performance at scale, and build a more personalized, data-driven communication experience.

- 

Lead newsletter strategy and monetization: Develop and execute a global newsletter roadmap across 22 markets, balancing sponsored placements, commissionable offers, campaign frequency, audience engagement, and long-term subscriber health.

- 

Manage high-volume campaign execution: Oversee more than 40 newsletter campaigns per week, managing planning, creative development, quality assurance, scheduling, deployment, and post-campaign analysis.

- 

Optimize commercial performance: Partner with advertising sales and merchant teams to advise on inventory, placements, targeting, and campaign best practices, using reliable performance data to improve partner outcomes and revenue potential.

- 

Own deliverability and sender reputation: Manage inbox placement, sending-domain health, IP and domain warm-up, email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and mailbox-provider requirements across multiple markets.

- 

Drive experimentation and optimization: Develop mobile-first, flexible email templates and run continuous A/B testing across creative, offers, segmentation, personalization, and send timing to improve engagement and campaign effectiveness.

- 

Build audience segmentation and personalization: Deliver targeted messaging based on market, client, member behavior, and relevant preferences, ensuring that audience selection and campaign placements respect client-specific settings.

- 

Develop lifecycle marketing journeys: Design and optimize automated activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back campaigns that increase engagement, improve retention, and strengthen long-term member value.

- 

Support product marketing and go-to-market initiatives: Oversee targeted campaigns that increase awareness and adoption of proprietary products and service categories, collaborating with marketing stakeholders on launch objectives and execution.

- 

Establish performance measurement and reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators across engagement, deliverability, lifecycle, and commercial outcomes, including open rates, click-through rates (CTR), click-to-open rates (CTOR), and sender reputation.

- 

Ensure trustworthy analytics: Maintain accurate, defensible campaign and partner reporting, accounting for bots, email scanners, prefetch activity, and other invalid traffic that may distort engagement metrics, in partnership with analytics teams.

- 

Lead and develop the email marketing team: Coach and manage a growing team of email marketers and specialists, establishing clear expectations, encouraging professional development, and maintaining high execution standards.

- 

Improve operational processes: Strengthen campaign intake, approvals, quality assurance, reporting, and cross-functional communication to improve efficiency, consistency, and accountability.

- 

Manage technology and vendor relationships: Oversee relationships with email service providers (ESPs), customer data platforms (CDPs), and deliverability vendors, contributing to platform strategy, capability assessments, and potential migrations.

- 

Maintain regulatory compliance: Ensure email marketing practices comply with applicable privacy and email regulations, including CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR, while overseeing consent, subscription, and preference management.

- 

Collaborate with senior leadership: Serve as a strategic partner to marketing leadership, communicating campaign performance, emerging trends, risks, and priorities while recommending data-driven improvements.

## Requirements:

- 

Extensive email marketing experience: At least nine years of hands-on email marketing experience in a high-volume environment, including seven or more years managing newsletters or email programs monetized through sponsored placements, affiliate revenue, or commissionable offers.

- 

Newsletter monetization expertise: Demonstrated experience operating recurring newsletter programs, maintaining campaign and inventory calendars, balancing paid placements with audience needs, and optimizing commercial performance.

- 

Advanced deliverability knowledge: Deep practical expertise in inbox placement, sender reputation, IP and domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, list hygiene, and mailbox-provider relationships.

- 

Enterprise marketing technology proficiency: Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise email service provider and CDP or marketing automation stack. Experience with Iterable, Lytics, or comparable platforms is particularly relevant.

- 

Segmentation and automation expertise: Strong command of audience segmentation, behavioral targeting, dynamic content, personalization, triggered campaigns, automated lifecycle journeys, and marketing automation workflows.

- 

Campaign optimization skills: Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, developing reusable email templates, improving campaign quality, and translating findings into practical optimization strategies.

- 

Analytics and attribution expertise: Advanced understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, performance measurement, KPI development, and dashboard reporting, including the ability to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.

- 

People leadership: A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing email marketing teams while maintaining a hands-on approach to execution and problem-solving.

- 

Commercial and cross-functional judgment: Ability to balance revenue objectives, partner requirements, audience experience, deliverability, and long-term subscriber value while collaborating across marketing, sales, merchant, and analytics functions.

- 

Communication and stakeholder management: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present performance insights and strategic recommendations clearly to partners, executives, and cross-functional teams.

- 

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 

Preferred industry background: Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, employee perks and benefits, affiliate marketing, deals, newsletter publishing, or media monetization.

- 

Additional preferred experience: Familiarity with HR benefits and employee engagement, multi-tenant marketing programs, product marketing and go-to-market campaigns, global email operations, and ESP evaluation or migration.

- 

Working style: A strategic yet execution-oriented leader who can manage competing priorities, solve technical challenges, continuously test new approaches, and develop scalable processes.

## Benefits:

- 

Annual compensation: $115,000–$130,000 base salary, plus bonus.

- 

Medical and dental insurance: Employer pays 75% of monthly contributions.

- 

Telehealth coverage: 100% employer-paid.

- 

Vision insurance: 100% employer-paid monthly contributions.

- 

Domestic partner coverage: Available across all insurance plans.

- 

Life insurance: 100% employer-paid life insurance.

- 

Retirement savings: 401(k) retirement plan options, including an employer contribution.

- 

Paid time off: Generous paid time off (PTO) and sick time off (STO) programs.

- 

Parental leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave policies.

- 

Paid holidays: 11 holidays annually, including an office closure day after Thanksgiving.

- 

Flexible spending accounts: Access to a flexible spending account program.

- 

Additional voluntary benefits: Options including short-term disability, long-term disability, supplemental life insurance, accident coverage, and cancer coverage.

- 

Remote work: Remote position based in the United States.

- 

Leadership and growth opportunities: The chance to shape global newsletter strategy, lead a growing team, and influence commercial performance across multiple markets.

 How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

The Manager, Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing go-to-market strategies for enterprise B2B SaaS solutions within the digital supply chain technology sector. You will drive product positioning, messaging, launches, and promotional initiatives that strengthen market differentiation and accelerate business growth. Working closely with product, sales, and marketing teams, you will translate complex technology capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with enterprise buyers. Through customer research, competitive intelligence, and market analysis, you will identify opportunities to refine target audiences, optimize product packaging, and improve commercial performance. You will also equip sales teams with the resources and insights they need to increase pipeline generation, deal velocity, and conversion rates. This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, customer-focused marketing professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is passionate about transforming supply chain operations through technology.

- Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product positioning, messaging, packaging, and promotional plans across a portfolio of enterprise SaaS solutions. Partner with sales and marketing leaders to refine ideal customer profiles (ICPs), establish quarterly growth priorities, and align initiatives with broader business objectives.

- Product Launches and Portfolio Management: Lead end-to-end product launch planning, coordination, and execution, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful releases, effective market communication, and strong customer adoption across multiple products.

- Market Research and Competitive Intelligence: Conduct customer research, analyze industry trends, and evaluate the competitive landscape to identify market opportunities, strengthen differentiation, and inform product marketing priorities, packaging decisions, and campaign strategies.

- Sales Enablement and Revenue Growth: Develop and deliver sales enablement materials, competitive positioning tools, and practical resources that help sales teams communicate product value, accelerate sales cycles, improve win rates, and drive pipeline and revenue growth.

- Customer-Centric Messaging and Content Development: Collaborate with content and marketing teams to create compelling marketing assets, including case studies, product videos, whitepapers, blog posts, and solution-focused materials. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, persuasive messaging tailored to different buyer personas and stages of the purchasing journey.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong working relationships with product management, sales, and marketing stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging, coordinated execution, and alignment between customer needs, product capabilities, and commercial objectives.

- Performance Measurement and Optimization: Track and analyze product marketing KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness, product adoption, pipeline contribution, and business impact. Use performance insights to refine go-to-market strategies and continuously improve results.

- Messaging and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to transform complex technical concepts into clear, compelling value propositions tailored to distinct customer personas and stakeholders throughout the buying journey.

- Sales Enablement and Commercial Acumen: Experience developing sales tools, competitive intelligence resources, and product marketing content that supports sales effectiveness, improves conversion rates, and strengthens revenue performance.

- Project Management and Organization: Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and deliver high-quality work within competing deadlines.

job.title: Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in United States.

As Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead, you will own the digital experience that turns visitors into customers and first-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers. You will lead website optimization, lifecycle marketing, email communication, and brand positioning across multiple product lines. Working closely with leadership, product, design, engineering, and marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into compelling messaging and measurable business outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, experiment with new ideas, and implement improvements from concept to execution. In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue. This is an opportunity for a hands-on marketing leader who combines analytical thinking, persuasive copywriting, and a strong sense of ownership to drive meaningful growth.

- 

Website Strategy and Conversion Optimization: Own the structure, messaging, and conversion performance of the website and key product pages. Develop and execute A/B tests, collaborate with design and engineering teams, and implement improvements that increase conversion rates.

- 

Lifecycle Marketing: Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding, reorder triggers, retention campaigns, win-back initiatives, and repeat-purchase flows. Partner with the Head of Marketing to drive recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.

- 

Positioning and Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for each product line and customer segment. Maintain a consistent source of truth for messaging across the website, advertising, sales materials, and AI-powered sales tools.

- 

Email Marketing: Plan, write, launch, and optimize lifecycle and marketing email campaigns that support customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

- 

Customer Research and Insights: Gather insights from sales calls, customer conversations, and reviews, translating them into stronger messaging, improved web pages, and actionable experimentation opportunities.

- 

Performance Measurement and Reporting: Track and analyze business-critical metrics, including conversion rates, repeat revenue, repeat order value, and CRM performance. Use data to prioritize initiatives and demonstrate measurable impact.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership and relevant teams to influence product direction, improve customer workflows, and align marketing execution with broader business objectives.

### Requirements:

- 

Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience in B2B or e-commerce marketing, with hands-on ownership of website conversion optimization, messaging, lifecycle marketing, or email programs.

-

job.title: Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager based in the United States.

The Senior Email Marketing Technology & CRM Manager will lead the technical planning and optimization of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs. This role focuses on Salesforce Marketing Cloud, email deliverability, audience segmentation, and the data infrastructure needed to power effective marketing campaigns. You will translate business objectives into technical requirements, ensuring that marketing initiatives are scalable, measurable, and operationally sound. Working closely with marketing, analytics, data, engineering, and operations teams, you will drive alignment and successful program execution. You will help strengthen email performance by improving audience quality, data integrity, inbox placement, and campaign readiness. This position offers the opportunity to influence marketing technology strategy and build efficient, repeatable processes within a complex enterprise environment. The role is remote, with New York preferred, and is offered as a six-month contract with a full-time, 40-hour workweek.

- 

Marketing Technology and Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Provide technical guidance on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) configuration, setup, and operational best practices. Support the planning and implementation of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs.

- 

Technical Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate existing marketing technology workflows and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, operational efficiency, and campaign execution.

- 

Requirements Definition: Translate marketing objectives into actionable technical specifications covering data inputs, audience logic, tracking, measurement, and governance.

- 

Email Deliverability: Advise on sender reputation, email authentication, suppression strategies, list hygiene, and inbox placement. Identify technical and operational factors that may affect deliverability and campaign performance.

- 

Audience Segmentation and Data Readiness: Define and document audience creation requirements, including eligibility criteria, exclusions, segmentation logic, and holdout groups. Partner with analytics and data teams to validate audience availability, data quality, and segmentation accuracy.

- 

Cross-Functional Program Execution: Collaborate with marketing operations, analytics, engineering, data, and campaign execution teams to ensure technical requirements are understood and programs are delivered successfully.

- 

Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex technical concepts into clear implementation plans for business and technical stakeholders. Influence decisions and build consensus across cross-functional teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

- 

Campaign Readiness and Risk Management: Assess technical readiness before campaign launches, considering data availability, audience logic, measurement frameworks, and governance requirements. Identify potential execution risks and recommend practical solutions.

- 

Documentation and Process Improvement: Develop technical documentation, implementation guidelines, operational playbooks, and stakeholder communications to promote consistency, knowledge sharing, and scalable execution.

- 

Operational Excellence: Help establish more efficient marketing technology processes and improve the technical foundation supporting sophisticated email and lifecycle marketing initiatives.

## Requirements

- 

Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in email marketing technology, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or a related technical marketing discipline. Candidates with slightly less experience may be considered if they demonstrate exceptional expertise.

- 

Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Strong working knowledge of SFMC, including audience segmentation, data models, platform configuration, and operational workflows.

- 

Email Deliverability Expertise: Demonstrated understanding of sender reputation, authentication protocols, suppression strategies, list hygiene, and inbox placement optimization.

- 

Large-Scale Campaign Implementation: Experience supporting the technical implementation and operational execution of large-scale email marketing and lifecycle programs.

- 

Technical Requirements and Data Management: Ability to translate marketing goals into technical specifications involving audience definitions, data inputs, tracking, measurement, and governance.

- 

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and experience collaborating with analytics, data, and engineering teams to validate requirements, resolve issues, and improve campaign effectiveness.

- 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to collaborate across complex, matrixed organizations and influence stakeholders without direct managerial authority.

- 

Communication and Documentation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, document implementation processes, and facilitate stakeholder alignment.

- 

Project Coordination: Ability to coordinate implementation timelines, manage competing priorities, assess operational readiness, and drive projects forward in a dynamic environment.

- 

Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting large-scale content strategies or lifecycle marketing programs, broader expertise in email marketing strategy and campaign planning, and familiarity with consumer technology, digital platforms, enterprise marketing environments, and distributed teams.

- 

Language: Professional proficiency in English is required.

- 

Work Authorization: Candidates must be prepared to indicate whether they require current or future employment visa sponsorship in the United States.

## Benefits

- 

Contract duration: Six-month contract position.

- 

Work arrangement: Remote work within the United States, with New York preferred.

- 

Working hours: Full-time commitment of 40 hours per week, typically eight hours per day, Monday through Friday.

- 

Health insurance: Medical coverage options to support employee health and well-being.

- 

Dental and vision insurance: Coverage options for dental and vision care.

- 

Health Savings Account (HSA): Access to a health savings account.

- 

Life insurance: Life insurance coverage.

- 

Retirement plan: Access to a retirement savings plan.

- 

Paid time off: Paid leave to support personal needs and work-life balance.

- 

Professional impact: The opportunity to shape the technical infrastructure behind sophisticated email marketing programs and improve marketing effectiveness at scale.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Marketing Lead based in the United States.

The Product Marketing Lead will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for an enterprise event technology platform serving complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field experiences. This high-impact role combines product storytelling, competitive strategy, product launches, sales enablement, and analyst relations. You will translate sophisticated platform capabilities, including emerging AI-powered and agentic features, into clear value propositions for enterprise buyers. Working closely with Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, you will help strengthen competitive performance and accelerate customer adoption. Reporting directly to the Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer, you will have significant ownership and the autonomy to build, test, and improve marketing programs. The environment rewards initiative, excellent writing, practical AI adoption, and the ability to deliver measurable results without relying on a large team.

You will lead product marketing across positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales readiness, and customer engagement, ensuring that the product’s value is clearly communicated throughout the buyer and customer journey. Your key responsibilities will include:

- 

Own positioning and messaging: Develop and maintain compelling messaging for the event experience platform, translating AI-powered and agentic capabilities into clear, evidence-based value propositions for enterprise event leaders. Ensure consistency across marketing channels, sales conversations, and customer communications.

- 

Lead go-to-market launches: Partner with Product to understand product strategy and development priorities, then manage launches end to end, including messaging, launch planning, input on pricing and packaging, sales readiness, and customer communications.

- 

Strengthen competitive strategy: Monitor established event management platforms and emerging point solutions. Develop practical battlecards, discovery questions, objection-handling guidance, and competitive intelligence that help sales teams win deals. Conduct win/loss analyses to continuously improve positioning and sales effectiveness.

- 

Drive sales enablement: Create sales narratives, demo storylines, one-pagers, RFP content, and other field resources. Work with Sales and Solutions leadership to train teams and ensure new product capabilities are effectively presented and sold.

- 

Manage analyst relations: Own day-to-day relationships with Forrester and Gartner, coordinate briefings and evaluation submissions, and strengthen the company’s presence on review platforms such as G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.

- 

Build customer proof points: Collaborate with Account Management to develop case studies, customer reference programs, and measurable evidence supporting product claims and demonstrating business value.

- 

Increase product adoption: Partner with Account Management to encourage existing customers to use new capabilities through release communications, targeted programs, relevant content, and executive business reviews.

- 

Maintain the product marketing knowledge base: Keep messaging, product information, and competitive intelligence accurate and accessible, including the knowledge that powers internal AI tools and workflows. Use AI to automate repetitive go-to-market activities and improve operational efficiency.

- 

Deliver measurable results: During the first 90 days, develop a clear understanding of why the company wins and loses, refresh competitive materials, take ownership of analyst evaluation activities, and deliver an end-to-end launch. Within the first year, help improve competitive win rates, establish consistent launch practices, strengthen analyst and review-site positioning, and maintain trusted messaging for employees and AI agents.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B SaaS product marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, strong commercial judgment, and a practical approach to AI-enabled work. Required and preferred qualifications include:

- 

At least five years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including experience as a lead or sole product marketer.

- 

Demonstrated ability to position complex platforms for both business and technical audiences and compete successfully against established market leaders.

- 

An AI-native approach to work, with experience using AI agents—ideally Claude—to automate practical go-to-market workflows and examples of solutions you have built.

- 

Strong sales enablement skills, including the ability to develop compelling narratives and useful sales materials, train field teams, and measure whether those resources are being adopted.

- 

Hands-on analyst relations experience, ideally including participation in a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.

- 

Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to make complex product concepts clear, specific, and persuasive without resorting to generic messaging.

- 

Ability to work independently, set priorities, move quickly, and deliver results in an environment with limited layers and a lean team structure.

- 

Preferred: Experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in everyday work.

- 

Preferred: Background in event technology, marketing technology, or another platform serving marketing teams.

- 

Preferred: Experience marketing AI-first or agentic products to enterprise customers.

- 

Preferred: Experience developing value propositions for multiple stakeholder groups, such as organizers, attendees, and sponsors.

- 

Preferred: Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, including the ability to retrieve and analyze data directly from these platforms.

Benefits:

- 

Annual salary: $100,000–$150,000, as stated in the source posting under New York pay transparency requirements.

- 

Comprehensive insurance options with employer premium coverage.

- 

Generous paid time-off benefits.

- 

Quarterly mental health days to support employee well-being.

- 

Quarterly team-building events designed to strengthen collaboration and workplace connections.

- 

401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

- 

Equity program.

- 

Paid parental leave.

- 

Sabbatical leave on milestone work anniversaries.

- 

An opportunity to shape product marketing strategy, influence competitive performance, and work closely with senior leadership.

- 

A collaborative, AI-forward environment that encourages experimentation, workflow automation, and independent execution.

job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Compute based in the United States.

Join a fast-growing technology environment at the intersection of artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and global connectivity. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own the go-to-market strategy for a portfolio of AI compute products, including inference APIs, embeddings, AI gateways, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. You will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling positioning, measurable campaigns, and clear value propositions for machine learning teams and voice AI developers. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation, you will lead product launches, competitive initiatives, and sales enablement. You will also use AI agents and automation to streamline marketing operations and improve execution at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor opportunity offering significant ownership, direct business impact, and the chance to shape how emerging AI infrastructure products reach the market.

- Own product positioning and messaging: Develop and maintain compelling positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions across the AI compute portfolio, including serverless inference, dedicated GPU solutions, embeddings, AI Gateway, and decision models.

- Lead end-to-end product launches: Coordinate launch strategies, product tiers, briefs, announcements, email campaigns, web pages, sales enablement materials, and post-launch performance reviews for a rapidly evolving product portfolio.

- Develop technical proof points: Lead public benchmarking initiatives in collaboration with Engineering, evaluating latency, model quality, throughput, and cost. Translate rigorous benchmark results into credible marketing assets, technical content, and sales materials.

- Build the AI economics narrative: Create total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses, savings calculators, pricing narratives, and competitive positioning that demonstrate the value of the infrastructure against hyperscalers and hosted inference providers.

- Drive integrated demand generation: Partner with Demand Generation to develop competitive campaigns, webinars, paid initiatives, and other programs, defining target audiences, ideal customer profiles (ICPs), campaign briefs, offers, and conversion journeys.

- Improve product activation and lifecycle marketing: Design targeted lifecycle email strategies and activation campaigns based on customer profiles and product usage, collaborating with Sales and go-to-market engineering teams to implement them.

- Enable sales teams: Produce competitive battlecards, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, sales presentations, training sessions, and pricing resources that help account executives and business development representatives communicate product value effectively.

- Monitor the competitive landscape: Track developments across inference platforms, speech technology providers, GPU cloud services, and hyperscaler AI offerings. Share competitive insights with Product and Engineering to inform roadmap decisions.

- Represent the product portfolio externally: Contribute to analyst briefings, customer success stories, press opportunities, and other initiatives that strengthen market credibility and awareness.

- Adopt AI-first marketing operations: Use and continuously improve AI agents and automated workflows for reporting, campaign tracking, ICP research, and content production, helping the marketing organization operate more efficiently.

- Drive measurable business outcomes: Partner with Sales and other stakeholders to improve inference consumption, dedicated GPU contract value, and pipeline generated by product launches and marketing campaigns.

## Requirements:

- Relevant experience: At least 5 years of product marketing experience in developer-focused infrastructure, with a minimum of 2 years working with AI/ML, cloud compute, GPU infrastructure, or data platform products.

- AI-first operating mindset: Practical experience using AI agents and automation as core components of marketing workflows. Ability to work with shared agents and continuously develop or improve autonomous workflows for research, reporting, campaign tracking, and content creation.

- Technical fluency: Ability to explain inference serving, GPU economics, latency and throughput trade-offs, and speech model quality to both technical audiences, such as ML engineers, and business stakeholders, including finance leaders.

- Product launch expertise: Proven experience managing launches for fast-moving product portfolios, ideally with monthly or more frequent releases. Ability to demonstrate repeatable launch processes, not just individual campaign successes.

- Exceptional communication skills: Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear, persuasive, technically accurate product pages, launch briefs, competitive battlecards, sales narratives, and marketing content at pace.

- Commercial ownership: Comfort working with Sales and other business teams to influence measurable outcomes, including product consumption, pipeline generation, and total contract value (TCV).

- Analytical and strategic thinking: Ability to translate technical differentiation, customer needs, competitive intelligence, and performance data into actionable go-to-market strategies.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Generation, and other teams in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have:

- Experience marketing usage-based or consumption-priced products.

- Hands-on familiarity with inference APIs, open-weight models, or speech APIs, including the ability to run technical demonstrations from the command line.

- Previous experience at a hosted inference, speech technology, or GPU cloud provider, or in marketing directly against these competitors.

- Exposure to analyst relations, including organizations such as Gartner, Frost & Sullivan, or G2.

- Experience developing customer success stories and programs that demonstrate product value through real-world results.

- Familiarity with AI infrastructure, developer tools, and technical products aimed at machine learning teams and voice AI builders.

## Benefits:

- High-impact ownership: Lead go-to-market strategy for an entire AI compute product line, with meaningful responsibility for positioning, launches, campaigns, and commercial outcomes.

- Cutting-edge technology: Work directly with AI inference products, dedicated GPU infrastructure, embeddings, and AI gateway technologies.

- AI-driven work environment: Use advanced AI agents, automation, and emerging tools as integral parts of your daily marketing workflows.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with experienced professionals across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation.

- Professional growth: Develop expertise at the intersection of AI infrastructure, product marketing, and developer-focused technology.

- Measurable business impact: Contribute directly to product adoption, inference consumption, pipeline generation, and revenue growth.

- Flexible work location: Opportunities available in the United States, with additional location options in Dublin, Ireland, and London, United Kingdom, according to the original posting.

- Autonomy and innovation: Operate as a senior individual contributor with ownership of a strategic product portfolio and opportunities to improve marketing processes through automation.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Compute based in the United States.

Join a fast-growing technology environment at the intersection of artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and global connectivity. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own the go-to-market strategy for a portfolio of AI compute products, including inference APIs, embeddings, AI gateways, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. You will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling positioning, measurable campaigns, and clear value propositions for machine learning teams and voice AI developers. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation, you will lead product launches, competitive initiatives, and sales enablement. You will also use AI agents and automation to streamline marketing operations and improve execution at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor opportunity offering significant ownership, direct business impact, and the chance to shape how emerging AI infrastructure products reach the market.

- Own product positioning and messaging: Develop and maintain compelling positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions across the AI compute portfolio, including serverless inference, dedicated GPU solutions, embeddings, AI Gateway, and decision models.

- Lead end-to-end product launches: Coordinate launch strategies, product tiers, briefs, announcements, email campaigns, web pages, sales enablement materials, and post-launch performance reviews for a rapidly evolving product portfolio.

- Develop technical proof points: Lead public benchmarking initiatives in collaboration with Engineering, evaluating latency, model quality, throughput, and cost. Translate rigorous benchmark results into credible marketing assets, technical content, and sales materials.

- Build the AI economics narrative: Create total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses, savings calculators, pricing narratives, and competitive positioning that demonstrate the value of the infrastructure against hyperscalers and hosted inference providers.

- Drive integrated demand generation: Partner with Demand Generation to develop competitive campaigns, webinars, paid initiatives, and other programs, defining target audiences, ideal customer profiles (ICPs), campaign briefs, offers, and conversion journeys.

- Improve product activation and lifecycle marketing: Design targeted lifecycle email strategies and activation campaigns based on customer profiles and product usage, collaborating with Sales and go-to-market engineering teams to implement them.

- Enable sales teams: Produce competitive battlecards, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, sales presentations, training sessions, and pricing resources that help account executives and business development representatives communicate product value effectively.

- Monitor the competitive landscape: Track developments across inference platforms, speech technology providers, GPU cloud services, and hyperscaler AI offerings. Share competitive insights with Product and Engineering to inform roadmap decisions.

- Represent the product portfolio externally: Contribute to analyst briefings, customer success stories, press opportunities, and other initiatives that strengthen market credibility and awareness.

- Adopt AI-first marketing operations: Use and continuously improve AI agents and automated workflows for reporting, campaign tracking, ICP research, and content production, helping the marketing organization operate more efficiently.

- Drive measurable business outcomes: Partner with Sales and other stakeholders to improve inference consumption, dedicated GPU contract value, and pipeline generated by product launches and marketing campaigns.

## Requirements:

- Relevant experience: At least 5 years of product marketing experience in developer-focused infrastructure, with a minimum of 2 years working with AI/ML, cloud compute, GPU infrastructure, or data platform products.

- AI-first operating mindset: Practical experience using AI agents and automation as core components of marketing workflows. Ability to work with shared agents and continuously develop or improve autonomous workflows for research, reporting, campaign tracking, and content creation.

- Technical fluency: Ability to explain inference serving, GPU economics, latency and throughput trade-offs, and speech model quality to both technical audiences, such as ML engineers, and business stakeholders, including finance leaders.

- Product launch expertise: Proven experience managing launches for fast-moving product portfolios, ideally with monthly or more frequent releases. Ability to demonstrate repeatable launch processes, not just individual campaign successes.

- Exceptional communication skills: Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear, persuasive, technically accurate product pages, launch briefs, competitive battlecards, sales narratives, and marketing content at pace.

- Commercial ownership: Comfort working with Sales and other business teams to influence measurable outcomes, including product consumption, pipeline generation, and total contract value (TCV).

- Analytical and strategic thinking: Ability to translate technical differentiation, customer needs, competitive intelligence, and performance data into actionable go-to-market strategies.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Generation, and other teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Hands-on familiarity with inference APIs, open-weight models, or speech APIs, including the ability to run technical demonstrations from the command line.

- Exposure to analyst relations, including organizations such as Gartner, Frost & Sullivan, or G2.

A strong experimentation mindset, with the ability to test frequently, learn quickly, and reallocate investment away from underperforming campaigns.

Hands-on experience with HubSpot and paid acquisition platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.

- 

Proven experience improving conversion throughout the marketing funnel, from initial engagement to booked and held meetings.

- 

Ability to forecast performance, communicate results clearly, and provide actionable recommendations to marketing and sales leadership.

- 

Strong execution and prioritization skills, with a focus on progress, measurement, and continuous iteration rather than perfection.

- 

An AI-native approach to work, including experience using AI tools and agents to automate tasks, build workflows, and improve efficiency.

-

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

job.title: Social Media Marketing Manager
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Marketing Manager based in United States.

We are seeking an experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to lead social media strategy, content creation, and audience growth for a leading blockchain ecosystem. In this high-impact role, you will shape the brand's digital presence, manage multiple social accounts, and develop engaging content that connects with global Web3 communities. You will transform complex technical concepts, product updates, and campaign narratives into compelling, platform-native stories that drive engagement and adoption. Working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, you will oversee creative execution, video content, community engagement, and performance optimization. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to streamline workflows, enhance creativity, and scale content production while maintaining brand integrity. This fully remote contract opportunity is ideal for a strategic, data-driven marketer who thrives in fast-moving technology environments and understands the evolving social media landscape.

- Social Media Strategy and Channel Management: Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies, primarily focused on X/Twitter, while managing and growing five or more brand accounts with consistent messaging and strategic alignment.

- Growth and Performance Optimization: Establish KPIs and performance benchmarks, monitor audience growth, engagement, and conversions, and identify opportunities to improve channel performance through data-driven decisions.

- Content Strategy and Creation: Translate brand positioning, technical developments, product launches, and marketing campaigns into engaging, platform-native content tailored to target audiences and community interests.

- Creative and Video Production: Develop and direct high-quality content across multiple formats, including short-form videos, livestreams, and serialized content. Collaborate with designers, motion specialists, and other creative partners to deliver impactful social experiences.

- Editorial Planning: Maintain a strategic editorial calendar that balances consistent daily publishing with major announcements, campaign launches, and timely industry developments.

- AI-Powered Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate content ideation, research, drafting, production, and publishing. Identify new technologies and implement efficient workflows without compromising quality, authenticity, or brand consistency.

- Analytics and Reporting: Own organic social performance tracking, analyze trends and audience behavior, and present clear insights, results, and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular basis.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, partnerships, design, events, and communications teams to coordinate messaging, align campaign execution, and maintain a cohesive brand narrative across channels.

- Community Engagement: Monitor social channels for emerging trends, audience sentiment, and engagement opportunities. Respond thoughtfully to conversations and help strengthen community relationships, trust, and brand credibility.

- Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about evolving social platforms, emerging formats, creator trends, and AI-powered marketing capabilities, translating relevant developments into actionable recommendations.

## Requirements

- Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in social media marketing and content marketing, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and hands-on execution.

- Social Media Expertise: Proven success managing multiple brand accounts, growing audiences, increasing engagement, and delivering measurable business or marketing outcomes.

- Web3 and Emerging Technology Knowledge: Experience in blockchain, cryptocurrency, Web3, or other emerging technology sectors. Familiarity with Crypto Twitter/X, developer ecosystems, and builder communities is a strong advantage.

- Content Development: Excellent editorial judgment and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex technical subjects and strategic narratives into clear, compelling, audience-focused content.

- Video and Creative Production: Hands-on experience planning, producing, directing, or managing video content for social platforms, including short-form video and livestreams.

- AI and Workflow Automation: Practical experience using AI tools to support content creation, research, ideation, and workflow optimization, with the ability to evaluate and adopt relevant tools.

- Data Analysis: Strong analytical skills and experience using social media metrics, performance dashboards, and audience insights to refine strategy and communicate results to leadership.

- Project and Stakeholder Management: Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts, concurrent campaigns, competing priorities, and cross-functional projects independently.

job.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager - Business & Government
job.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager – Business & Government based in the United States.

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager will drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across the Business & Government market by building and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns. This role connects go-to-market strategy with measurable pipeline generation, combining account-based marketing, digital demand generation, and field event activation. You will own campaign planning and execution from initial brief through launch, optimization, and performance reporting, with direct accountability for pipeline contribution and conversion outcomes. Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Customer Growth teams, you will align messaging, audience targeting, and campaign performance with business objectives. You will also lead data-driven event strategies and explore AI-powered workflows to improve personalization, efficiency, and campaign effectiveness. This is an opportunity for a strategic yet hands-on marketer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and embraces emerging technologies to accelerate growth.

- 

Campaign Strategy and Execution: Own the integrated campaign calendar for new customer acquisition across the Business & Government segment, defining measurable pipeline targets for every program. Translate go-to-market positioning and competitive differentiation into compelling, audience-specific campaigns and assets.

- 

Multi-Channel Demand Generation: Plan and execute campaigns across paid media, email, content syndication, webinars, and field events. Coordinate with channel teams to maximize performance and ensure programs complement one another.

- 

Account-Based Marketing: Design, launch, and optimize account-based marketing programs targeting priority organizations, using account-level insights and buying signals to improve engagement and conversion.

- 

AI-Driven Marketing Innovation: Build and implement AI-powered workflows and automations for campaign analysis, audience personalization, and performance optimization. Support visibility in AI-generated research environments by coordinating generative engine optimization initiatives and adapting strategies to evolving buyer behavior.

- 

Field and Event Marketing: Coordinate regional activations, roadshows, executive dinners, partner-hosted events, and conference participation in collaboration with the Events team. Contribute to flagship customer events by integrating field activities with broader campaign strategies and pipeline objectives.

- 

Pipeline Generation and Attribution: Own a direct pipeline contribution target, monitor results weekly, and adjust campaigns when performance falls short. Partner with Marketing Intelligence to establish campaign-level targets, analyze intent data, track sourced and influenced pipeline, and maintain multi-touch attribution models.

- 

Content and Asset Development: Collaborate with Content, Brand, Creative, and Product Marketing teams to develop landing pages, nurture emails, digital advertisements, one-pagers, sales enablement materials, event briefs, and post-event follow-up sequences.

- 

Marketing Operations and Lead Management: Work with Marketing Operations to support audience segmentation, lead routing, campaign tracking, and reporting through HubSpot or Marketo and Salesforce.

- 

Customer Growth Coordination: Identify customer engagement trends, advocacy opportunities, and expansion signals, sharing relevant insights with Customer Growth and Advocacy teams to inform post-sale initiatives.

- 

Performance Reporting and Optimization: Track key performance indicators, including pipeline contribution, MQL-to-SQL conversion, closed-won rates, cost per opportunity, and event ROI. Test and optimize messaging, creative assets, calls to action, and audience segments.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Present campaign insights and recommendations during weekly pipeline reviews, partner closely with Sales and Customer Success, and influence stakeholders across teams to improve execution and ensure accurate campaign attribution.

## Requirements

- 

Professional Experience: 8–10 years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within EdTech, SaaS, or another complex enterprise environment.

- 

Pipeline Generation Expertise: Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and contribute measurably to revenue, rather than focusing solely on lead volume.

- 

Account-Based Marketing: Hands-on experience designing, executing, and measuring account-based marketing programs at the target-account level.

- 

Field and Event Marketing: Experience managing conference participation, regional marketing programs, and event budgets from planning through execution, including post-event attribution and ROI measurement.

- 

AI and Automation Skills: Practical experience building AI-enabled workflows and automations as part of day-to-day marketing operations, with examples of implementation and measurable results.

- 

Marketing Technology: Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or Marketo and Salesforce, including lead management, campaign tracking, and attribution processes.

- 

Intent Data and Targeting: Experience using intent data platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar tools to identify buying signals, prioritize audiences, and personalize campaigns.

- 

Paid Media and Agency Management: Experience managing paid media agency relationships across search, display, and programmatic advertising, as well as coordinating creative production.

- 

Analytics and Optimization: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, take initiative, and make evidence-based adjustments.

- 

Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex positioning into persuasive campaign copy, clear creative briefs, and executive-ready performance summaries.

- 

Collaboration and Ownership: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional contributors, and influence Sales and Marketing stakeholders while maintaining productive relationships.

- 

Language Proficiency: Fluency in written and spoken English.

- 

Preferred Qualifications: Experience marketing to corporate, government, or public-sector audiences; familiarity with generative engine optimization (GEO) and improving visibility in AI-generated answers; experience with AI-powered sales development platforms or outbound sequencing tools; and involvement in flagship customer events or user conferences as part of integrated campaign strategies.

- 

Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and maintain that authorization throughout employment. Visa sponsorship and immigration support are not available for this position.

## Benefits

- 

Competitive base salary: Expected annual salary range of $105,200–$150,000. The final offer depends on experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location.

- 

Additional compensation: Potential company bonus or other compensation beyond the stated base salary.

- 

Remote work: Opportunity to work remotely from within the United States.

- 

Collaborative environment: Cross-functional partnership with teams spanning Revenue Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Intelligence, Marketing Operations, Brand, and Customer Growth.

- 

Innovation and development: Opportunity to build AI-powered marketing workflows, experiment with emerging technologies, and influence campaign strategy across a growing market segment.
