job.title: Digital Marketing B2B HubSpot Growth Marketing and Automation Manager (Remote)
job.description:
Logical Media Group strives to create exceptional digital experiences for people to connect, transact, and explore. At the core of that lies with our partnership with our clients and ensuring their needs and goals are at the forefront of all our efforts. The focus of the B2B HubSpot Growth Marketing Manager will be to serve as an integral role in identifying and creating high value and high impact strategies for our clients across delivery and account management teams; this will involve supporting CRM standards and program strategies through omni-channel collaboration, monitoring the success of those initiatives, and continually enhancing and optimizing that service value for our clients. This role will primarily focus on the ideation and execution of B2B marketing and customer journey initiatives for our clients, contributing to the growth of this channel at Logical. 

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities Include: 

Working across Account Teams

- Collaborate with cross-functional account teams to ensure seamless execution of high impact initiatives and consumer journeys from kickoff to launch, with special attention to how client’s sales and marketing teams need to collaborate 

- Focus on the core business KPIs for clients, develop and implement cross-channel programs that align to key moments of need within the customer’s journey based on insights from analytics and behavioral science

- Partner with client stakeholders to operationalize program-based strategies and develop cross-channel programs and initiatives that increase key performance indicators

- Lead strategic meetings (both internally and externally) to align on client goals and ensure that programs are operating in service of unique customer journey needs

- Work across accounts to oversee the creation of emails, forms, landing pages, reports, and other related infrastructure to optimize performance of our marketing efforts

- Build custom multi channel reports and implement reporting processes that capture key insights, and define account success, while also identifying opportunities for continued improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and impact of the complex, consumer-centric marketing strategies

- Maintain data hygiene and data/list integrity standards, including managing data and integrations between marketing and sales platforms (Hubspot, Salesforce, Marketo, Pardot, etc), and creating standards if they do not exist

- Participate in campaign planning to develop and maintain all project aspects, including timelines/schedules, budget, progress/status reports, and messaging/copy if needed.

- Identify customer segments for targeted marketing programs and plan consumer loyalty and engagement programs to deliver ROI-positive results

- Identify and mitigate risk, specifically how CRM changes may impact reporting and other processes; support account manager in managing client expectations, and ensuring client-delivery alignment between requirements and downstream deliverables.

Working with the Sales Team 

- Craft service narratives to communicate what we are building in service of our client’s mission, the outcomes we deliver to our customers, and the continued value Logical Media Group can provide to increase client success

- Assist Account Management and Director of Growth with creating clear business cases for new engagement opportunities, and get buy-in from key clients and stakeholders

- Articulate business and functional requirements of CRM, engaging in strategic storytelling to align and inspire a wide range of internal and external stakeholders

Requirements: 

- CRM platform proficiency, Hubspot preferred but not required. This includes but is not limited to competency in implementing, optimizing and speaking to workflows created as a part of a customer experience journey, list hygiene, and lead scoring. 

- An understanding of the nuances and challenges of tailoring performance marketing channels to unique customer journeys and/or Account Based Marketing needs

- Experience in identifying new marketing channels and target audiences, and devising marketing strategies that engage, inform and motivate innovation and ongoing optimization of performance for clients

- Comfortability with collaboration and presentation, both internally and client facing 

- Passion for creative problem-solving, working independently and sometimes without clear instruction. This position will be creating and optimizing processes in live time. 

- 2+ years of B2B strategy experience in-house or agency preferred 

Benefits

Logical Media Group Benefits

- Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, and Life insurance

- 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future

- Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.

- Flexible Fridays

- Option to work completely remote

- Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities

- Optional COVID safe company gatherings

Logical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company.

- An understanding of the nuances and challenges of tailoring performance marketing channels to unique customer journeys and/or Account Based Marketing needs

- Experience in identifying new marketing channels and target audiences, and devising marketing strategies that engage, inform and motivate innovation and ongoing optimization of performance for clients

- Comfortability with collaboration and presentation, both internally and client facing 

- Passion for creative problem-solving, working independently and sometimes without clear instruction. This position will be creating and optimizing processes in live time. 

- 2+ years of B2B strategy experience in-house or agency preferred

- 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future

- Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.

- Flexible Fridays

- Option to work completely remote

- Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities

job.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
Role at a glance

What: As Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own pipeline coverage and top-of-funnel demand gen end-to-end — deciding how we get there, not just executing a fixed plan.

Impact: You'll build and run the demand engine that gets Rally and our recently launched Agent and MCP in front of the buyers evaluating an AI-native research stack, directly shaping whether pipeline turns into revenue.

Team: You'll join our Marketing team and work closely with Sales, the founders, and cross-functional partners across Product and Engineering. At our size, the lines between them ebb and flow, so you'll always be working cross-functionally.

Where: Remote-first across the US, with hubs in New York and Boston.

About Rally

In a world where anyone can ship anything, the teams building closest to their users win. But talking to users is still way harder than it should be. Pulling lists, chasing consent, juggling calendars, sending incentives: it's why most product teams skip research altogether.

We're here to end manual recruitment.

Rally is agentic research infrastructure: the system that lets companies talk to their own users safely, at any scale. Tell Rally what you want to learn, and Rally Agent builds the study, finds the right participants, and handles outreach, scheduling, and incentives, all within your company's guardrails. It works from the Rally app, from Slack, or from the AI tools you already use. Agents handle the busywork, so people focus on the human parts: learning from each other.

Today, teams at Google, Meta, Figma, Ramp, Perplexity, and MongoDB run their research on Rally. And we're building a company that lasts, investing in the product and the team for the long haul.

The opportunity

We believe teams will always need to talk to their users, however far AI goes, and most companies still don't have a safe way to let team members outside of traditional UX Research do it. We recently launched Rally's Agent and MCP, and we're going after the biggest companies in the world. The product is catching up to the vision, with plenty of exciting challenges still ahead.

That's where you come in. You'd join Marketing, a small, high-ownership team that's a little obsessed with our users. We work side by side with the researchers and product builders who use Rally every day, and yes, we use Rally to build Rally.

This role exists because demand gen and pipeline need a dedicated owner unafraid to take risks — you'd own it end-to-end, with real latitude to build the approach that works.

What you'll do

- 

Identify and test new channels or tactics to diversify pipeline sources

- 

Run events, email marketing strategy, and social campaigns

- 

Partner with sales to align campaigns with pipeline targets and feedback from the field

- 

Collaborate with product marketing on product-focused campaigns and joint strategy building, ensuring positioning and messaging translate into pipeline-generating activity

- 

Continuously optimize based on CAC, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity

What you'll bring

- 

6+ years running demand gen or growth marketing, with a track record of owning a pipeline number and measurable results to show for it

- 

Built and owned experience across paid, events, and content

- 

Tech/SaaS background, startup to mid-market, comfortable operating with limited resources and ambiguity

- 

You'd rather figure out the right approach yourself than wait to be told what to do

Nice to have

- 

Managing paid campaigns (Google and LinkedIn) and hosted webinars

- 

Experience in UXR or adjacent research/product tooling

- 

Startup experience, particularly at Series A/B stage

Don’t check every box? Apply anyway. We care a lot more about what you can do than a perfect match to a list.

How we work

We’re remote-first, but we’re not strangers.

Async by default: We write things down, keep each other in the loop, and save meetings for decisions and real connection.

Together when it counts: We get together in person throughout the year to plan, build, and celebrate.

Owners, not order-takers: You’ll have real responsibility from day one and the trust to figure out how to get there.

User first, always: We talk to users constantly, and it shapes every decision we make.

AI-native, inside and out: We’re building an agentic product, and we work like it. Everyone here is experimenting with AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

This might not be for you if…

- 

You want a clearly defined lane. Roles here stretch, and priorities shift as we learn.

- 

You’d rather hand work off than own it end to end.

- 

You need a lot of process or a big team around you to do your best work.

- 

You're not curious about how AI is changing the way we work (we're rethinking it constantly).

- 

You'd rather guess what users want than go ask them.

- 

You need a big team or agency behind you to run paid, events, and content

If you read that and thought, “that’s exactly why I’d love it here,” we’d really like to hear from you!

Compensation & benefits

Base salary range (US): $120,000 - $140,000 USD per year.

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires in this role across the United States. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job‑related skills, experience, and location.

Additional compensation: This role is eligible for variable compensation such as equity in accordance with Rally’s applicable plans. Any such compensation is not guaranteed and is determined at Rally’s discretion under the terms of those plans.

We want you to feel taken care of, so you can do your best work. For US-based full-time employees, that includes:

- 

Competitive pay and meaningful equity

- 

Great medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 

14 weeks of fully paid parental leave, for every parent

- 

Unlimited PTO (and we want you to use it)

- 

Home office and co-working support

- 

Mental health and wellness support

- 

401(k)

- 

Opportunities for in-person time with coworkers

Benefits may vary based on role, level, and location, and are subject to change as Rally grows.

Our hiring process

We want interviewing with us to feel like a preview of working here: structured, transparent, and focused on real work. Steps can vary a bit by role, but here’s the usual flow:

- 

Recruiter chat (30 min): Get to know each other and make sure the role fits what you’re looking for.

- 

Hiring manager conversation (45 min): Dig into the role, your experience, and what success looks like.

- 

Practical exercise: A take-home or working session based on the work you’d actually do. No brain teasers.

- 

Final interviews: 3–5 conversations with future teammates, cross-functional partners, and one of our founders.

- 

References and offer: We move fast here.

We’ll tell you what to expect at every step. And since we’re a research company, we’d love your feedback on the process too.

We’re building a team that reflects the range of people who use products like ours, and we’re committed to paying fairly for the work. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market data for our size, stage, and industry, and may adjust over time as the market evolves.

Rally is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need support or an adjustment at any point, please let us know how we can help.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work for this role. It is not a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employment with Rally is “at will,” which means either you or Rally may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason or no reason at all.

job.title: Director, Marketing Technology
job.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

 

About the Role

Marketing at Step runs on data. Every acquisition channel, lifecycle campaign, rewards drop, and measurement decision depends on clean, connected, well-modeled data flowing between our product, our warehouse, and a dozen marketing platforms. Today, much of that work lands on engineering. We're hiring a Director, Marketing Technology, to own it end-to-end.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role for someone with a software or data engineering background who wants to apply that skill set to growth. You'll be the architect and operator of Step's marketing technology stack: owning our ad channel and attribution integrations, managing our vendor ecosystem (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and others), building the data models and analytical tooling the marketing team runs on, and shipping the monthly rewards and offers that drive engagement. You'll act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Engineering taking on the technical work that currently pulls engineers away from the core product, and raising the bar on what marketing can measure, automate, and personalize.

You'll start as a hands-on individual contributor with the opportunity to build and lead a marketing technology team as the function scales.

In this role, you will:

Own the marketing technology stack

  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Step's martech ecosystem including CDP, MMP, lifecycle messaging, data aggregation, and analytics tooling along with the documentation, QA, and governance standards that keep it reliable and privacy-compliant 
  • Manage all marketing technology partners (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and similar), including evaluation, implementation, optimization, and contract/renewal input

Build and optimize ad channel and measurement integrations

  • Configure, validate, and maintain integrations with paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar), including server-side conversion APIs, event schemas, setup counting methods, attribution windows, and first-party audience syncs 
  • Own attribution and mobile measurement (AppsFlyer/Segment): SKAN/postback configuration, conversion windows, deduplication, and channel-level data quality
  • Partner on GA4 implementation including event taxonomy, funnel conversion configuration, and custom reporting; leveraging GA4 data to fill attribution gaps across channels and inform incrementality analysis

Be the data backbone of the marketing team

  • Build and maintain the pipelines and data models that power marketing reporting, audience segmentation, and campaign measurement  with identity, event, and audience definitions kept consistent across product, warehouse, and activation platforms
  • Develop self-serve analytical tools, dashboards, and automations so marketers can answer their own questions (ie. spend pacing, funnel conversion, LTV, incrementality)

Ship marketing programs

  • Own the technical build of Step's monthly rewards and offers program end to end targeting logic, delivery, tracking, and post-campaign readout
  • Support lifecycle and CRM campaign execution in Braze: triggers and data feeds

Partner across the company

  • Serve as marketing's technical counterpart to Product, Engineering, and Data scoping requests, setting priorities, and taking build work off engineering's plate

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years across software engineering, data engineering, or marketing technology, with meaningful time spent as a hands-on engineer
  • Proven experience owning a modern martech stack at a consumer company: CDP (Segment or similar), MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), and lifecycle platforms (Braze or similar)
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in a scripting language (Python or JavaScript); comfortable with APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, and cloud data warehouses
  • Deep understanding of mobile and web attribution: conversion APIs, SKAdNetwork, postbacks, deduplication, and incrementality
  • A clear communicator who bridges marketing, engineering, and executive audiences
  • You are hungry for action and you'd rather ship a working solution this week than a perfect one next quarter
  • Experience operating martech at larger scale, ideally through viral moments or campaign-driven traffic spikes

Some of the technology we use:

  • Kotlin
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • Dagger
  • Postgres
  • JOOQ
  • BigQuery
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at people@step.com and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead go-to-market strategy, planning, and launches for the entire portfolio: core banking, credit, rewards, lending, and investing  
  • Own the cross-functional operations between Step and Beast Industries, developing and launching collabs, product integrations, and partnership expansion
  • Drive strategy and lead a full-funnel lifecycle marketing perspective from top-of-funnel awareness through ongoing engagement and retention
  • Deliver best-in-class loyalty and gamification programs at scale
  • Partner with the broader marketing team to execute campaigns that drive new signups, expansion, and/or product adoption

job.title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) / SVP, Growth / Director of Marketing
job.description:
Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) / SVP, Growth / Director of Marketing 
DTC Lead Generation | High-Volume, Performance-Driven
Superior Executive & Legal Recruiting is seeking a senior marketing leader to scale direct-to-consumer lead generation for a high-volume plaintiff-side employment litigation firm. Own the full funnel—from acquisition to intake to signed clients—with a focus on ROI, growth, and operational efficiency.
Target Background: Healthcare, insurance, financial services, education, or similar high-volume DTC sectors.

Responsibilities
Own and scale paid acquisition (Google Ads, Meta), managing $150K+ monthly spend
Drive full-funnel performance across landing pages, intake, and call center conversion
Build and optimize growth systems including testing frameworks, CRM/MarTech, and attribution
Improve speed-to-lead and conversion rates in partnership with intake and operations
Optimize across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels to maximize lead quality and signed clients

Qualifications
8+ years in DTC/performance marketing with proven revenue impact (not just CPL optimization)
Hands-on paid media experience building and managing campaigns directly
Experience in high-volume, complex funnel environments with strong testing and optimization rigor
Familiarity with multi-channel acquisition (paid, SEO, lifecycle) and CRM/MarTech systems
Proven leadership experience building and scaling high-performing teams
Critical Requirement:
Must have personal, hands-on experience (not solely team or agency oversight) building campaigns in Google Ads and Meta. While the CMO will not be expected to actively build campaigns as part of this position, deep subject matter expertise is the most important requirement of this job. Candidates must have executed campaign builds, optimizations, and creative strategy at a high level with six-figure budgets.

job.title: Field Marketing Manager
job.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
 
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. 
 
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. 

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing plans that generate awareness and drive pipeline growth across AHEAD’s Central Region. This highly collaborative role partners closely with marketing, sales, and external agencies to align strategy, ensure flawless execution, and report on performance and outcomes. 
Serving as the primary bridge between the Central Region and the broader marketing organization, you will ensure tight coordination across teams, consistency in messaging and branding, and effective activation of campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional deliverables. You’ll also champion regional engagement in national campaigns—helping to localize content, refine audience targeting, and align messaging to meet regional business needs. 
The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in field marketing and a hands-on approach to execution. This position reports directly to the Director of Field Marketing. It offers a unique opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on regional business growth. 

- 

Develop and execute integrated field and regional marketing strategies tailored to the Central Region, driving brand awareness, pipeline growth, and customer engagement across target accounts and industries. 

- 

Design and activate executive engagement programs, including CxO-level experiences and high-touch events that deepen relationships with strategic customers and prospects. 

- 

Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of regional demand generation and pipeline acceleration initiatives, aligned with both corporate and field priorities. 

- 

Partner closely with sales, product marketing, demand generation, and GTM teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on messaging, campaign strategy, and audience targeting. 

- 

Build and sustain strong relationships with GTM and technology partners to support brand consistency and deliver impactful co-marketing and partner programs across the region. 

- 

Drive and execute account-based marketing (ABM) strategies focused on high-value accounts, tailoring campaigns and events to accelerate sales cycles and increase engagement. 

- 

Manage and analyze campaign performance, KPIs, and ROI, using data and analytics to continually optimize programs and report impact to sales and marketing leadership. 

- 

Ensure clear and consistent communication with the regional sales team, educating on upcoming programs, assets, and global-to-local campaign activation opportunities. 

- 

Collaborate with national and global teams to scale successful programs across markets and ensure regional participation in corporate campaigns. 

- 

Lead the planning and flawless execution of high-touch regional events, customer roundtables, and partner activations—while also supporting key national initiatives led by the Experience Marketing team. 

- 

Oversee and manage the Central Region marketing budget, ensuring high-impact use of resources that deliver measurable business results. 

- 

Serve as a brand ambassador at industry conferences, executive forums, and customer engagements, strengthening AHEAD’s presence and visibility in the Central Region. 

The ideal candidate has a strong track record of executing field marketing strategies that drive revenue through compelling content, integrated programs, and measurable impact. They bring a deep understanding of marketing best practices across digital channels, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives with precision and creativity. 

- Minimum Required – 5+ Years of experience in similar role

- 

Proven experience developing and executing integrated, ROI-focused marketing and pipeline generation programs 

- 

Strong knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) strategies and execution 

- 

Demonstrated expertise in both project management and event execution 

- 

Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms, ideally including Marketo, Salesforce, and Demandbase 

- 

Highly analytical, with a passion for using data to drive decisions and optimize performance 

- 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

- 

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage time effectively across competing priorities 

- Willingness to travel up to 40% as needed for business needs.

 The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.  
 
Why AHEAD:
 
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
 
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
 
USA Employment Benefits include: 
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 
- 401(k) 
- Paid company holidays 
- Paid time off 
- Paid parental and caregiver leave 
- Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details. 
 
Use of AI:
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
 
If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Notice or contact us at privacy@ahead.com. 
 
You may opt-out of the review or analysis of your application and resume by AI tools by using the General Application. Please include the role you wish to apply for in the Additional Information field. You may also choose to opt-out of recording and transcription at any time, including after joining an interview.  Candidates will not be penalized for choosing to opt-out.

job.title: Senior Product Designer, Marketing Tools
job.description:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

 

About Toast

Our focus is on building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we’ll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future. We build experiences that help make operating and growing a restaurant and delighting guests easier and scalable. It’s why tens of thousands of restaurant locations love Toast.

About The Roll

You'll own the design of Toast's Marketing Tools: the surfaces restaurants use to reach guests, run campaigns, and understand what's working. This work sits as the foundation for our agentic marketing products, so the tools you design will increasingly be operated by, and alongside, AI agents. Restaurant operators are busy and rarely marketers by training, so the bar is a consumer-grade experience that gets them results without a manual.

You'll join the Guest Design team, which covers Digital Storefront, Marketing, and related agentic surfaces. You'll partner with a PM, an engineering lead, and designers working on CRM, Websites, Online Ordering, and the agentic teams that make life easier for restaurant operators. You'll set direction for Marketing Tools rather than take it as a spec. You'll also help shape how we measure whether the work is succeeding.

This is a growth role. You'll work on a mature set of tools with room to redefine them for an agent-assisted future, with direct exposure to senior design and product leadership. This is a remote role, preferably located on the east coast. We collaborate across U.S. and Ireland time zones, with occasional travel for team and planning sessions.

The right ingredients (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in a product design role, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of shipped work
  • Experience redesigning mature product lines, not only launching new ones
  • Strong systems thinking: you can design a coherent experience across multiple tools, workflows, and entry points
  • Fluency in Figma, plus comfort prototyping with AI tools to test ideas quickly
  • Experience working with PMs and Eng in a triad, and running independent research
  • A record of using data (usage, funnel, or experiment results) to make and defend design decisions
  • Experience with B2B or SMB products, ideally in marketing, CRM, or growth

Special Sauce (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience designing for AI-assisted or agentic workflows
  • Background in marketing automation, email/SMS, loyalty, or advertising products
  • Restaurant, hospitality, or small business industry experience
  • Experience mentoring other designers

About You

You are a dynamic team player with proven impact in previous roles who is ready and willing to take on new challenges! You’re excited to join the remotely distributed group of product designers, user researchers, design ops leaders, and product managers that compose the Toast Design team. You embody the tenets that drive Toast’s Design practice: 

  1. You have a founder’s mentality: and exhibit ownership of outcomes over outputs. You own the quality and outcomes associated with your work, as well as additional areas your work touches.
  2. You lift others up: and recognize you don’t have to be a manager to engage and exhibit true leadership. You offer help and guidance across all different collaborators you work with.
  3. You drive action through influence: and appreciate that building trusting and productive relationships with those around you is integral to driving action. You build strong relationships to enact influence with all key stakeholders of the area of the business you work within.
  4. You build strong perspectives: and guide yourself and your teams to make good decisions quickly and often. You collaboratively make well informed decisions by synthesizing a wide variety of data sources.
  5. You raise the bar: and commit to continually improving the technical skills relevant to your role. You actively engage in your own learning and development and deeply internalize learnings and lessons from your project work.

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

 

#LI-REMOTE



The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A
$159,000—$254,000 USD
Zone B
$138,000—$221,000 USD
Zone C
$125,000—$200,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

------

Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

 

About Toast

Our focus is on building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we’ll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future. We build experiences that help make operating and growing a restaurant and delighting guests easier and scalable. It’s why tens of thousands of restaurant locations love Toast.

About The Roll

You'll own the design of Toast's Marketing Tools: the surfaces restaurants use to reach guests, run campaigns, and understand what's working. This work sits as the foundation for our agentic marketing products, so the tools you design will increasingly be operated by, and alongside, AI agents. Restaurant operators are busy and rarely marketers by training, so the bar is a consumer-grade experience that gets them results without a manual.

You'll join the Guest Design team, which covers Digital Storefront, Marketing, and related agentic surfaces. You'll partner with a PM, an engineering lead, and designers working on CRM, Websites, Online Ordering, and the agentic teams that make life easier for restaurant operators. You'll set direction for Marketing Tools rather than take it as a spec. You'll also help shape how we measure whether the work is succeeding.

This is a growth role. You'll work on a mature set of tools with room to redefine them for an agent-assisted future, with direct exposure to senior design and product leadership. This is a remote role, preferably located on the east coast. We collaborate across U.S. and Ireland time zones, with occasional travel for team and planning sessions.

The right ingredients (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in a product design role, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of shipped work
  • Experience redesigning mature product lines, not only launching new ones
  • Strong systems thinking: you can design a coherent experience across multiple tools, workflows, and entry points
  • Fluency in Figma, plus comfort prototyping with AI tools to test ideas quickly
  • Experience working with PMs and Eng in a triad, and running independent research
  • A record of using data (usage, funnel, or experiment results) to make and defend design decisions
  • Experience with B2B or SMB products, ideally in marketing, CRM, or growth

Special Sauce (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience designing for AI-assisted or agentic workflows
  • Background in marketing automation, email/SMS, loyalty, or advertising products
  • Restaurant, hospitality, or small business industry experience
  • Experience mentoring other designers

About You

You are a dynamic team player with proven impact in previous roles who is ready and willing to take on new challenges! You’re excited to join the remotely distributed group of product designers, user researchers, design ops leaders, and product managers that compose the Toast Design team. You embody the tenets that drive Toast’s Design practice: 

  1. You have a founder’s mentality: and exhibit ownership of outcomes over outputs. You own the quality and outcomes associated with your work, as well as additional areas your work touches.
  2. You lift others up: and recognize you don’t have to be a manager to engage and exhibit true leadership. You offer help and guidance across all different collaborators you work with.
  3. You drive action through influence: and appreciate that building trusting and productive relationships with those around you is integral to driving action. You build strong relationships to enact influence with all key stakeholders of the area of the business you work within.
  4. You build strong perspectives: and guide yourself and your teams to make good decisions quickly and often. You collaboratively make well informed decisions by synthesizing a wide variety of data sources.
  5. You raise the bar: and commit to continually improving the technical skills relevant to your role. You actively engage in your own learning and development and deeply internalize learnings and lessons from your project work.

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

job.title: Manager, Marketing Operations - Ad Tech Lead
job.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We create technology to help businesses grow and succeed. Our Marketing Operations team is looking for a technically sharp, operationally minded Manager to own the infrastructure behind our paid media program — from pixel to pipeline, feed to finance. This role is the engine behind our buying team, ensuring every campaign we run is accurately tracked and our media buyers can focus on performance rather than data.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Own the full signal path for Paid: serve as the single technical owner across Tracking/Pixels, Program/Campaign, Audience/Conversions API, and Control Tower - partnering with Paid on requirements once and carrying them across every team, rather than Paid routing to individuals separately
  • Tag & pixel infrastructure: own event tracking, conversion signals, and audience data flows across ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Bing, ChatGPT, etc.) via offline conversion tracking and server-side tagging
  • Marketing automation: manage and optimize Marketo paid program setup, scoring, audience segmentation, and integration with ad platforms
  • Data operations: manage CRM audience syncs and data pipelines between source systems and ad platforms using ETL systems
  • UTM & tracking governance: define and enforce naming conventions, UTM taxonomy, QA checklists, and bulk build processes to ensure every campaign launched is trackable and consistent
  • Platform integrations & API management: manage connections between marketing tech systems (Marketo, Salesforce, ad platforms) and troubleshoot data discrepancies across the stack
  • Launch playbooks & QA framework: build and maintain the launch playbook for new vendors, channels, and tests; own time-to-launch as a core metric and continuously shrink it
  • Control Tower & monitoring: own Paid's coverage within our Control Tower alerting suite, publish and follow a QA cadence (daily monitors, monthly tests, quarterly audits), and drive down time-to-detect on data issues
  • Reporting & analytics infrastructure: maintain and QA the data pipelines that feed performance dashboards, ensuring campaign, lead, and conversion data is accurate and available for stakeholder reporting
  • Audience operations: build, maintain, and refresh CRM-based audience lists for suppression, retargeting, and lookalike seeding across ad platforms

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in marketing operations, ad tech, or marketing analytics
  • Experience managing infrastructure for paid spend at $10M+ a year across 3+ ad platforms
  • Hands-on experience with offline conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or equivalent), including sending CRM-stage conversions back to platforms
  • Experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Experience with CRM systems and lead routing logic (Salesforce or equivalent)
  • Experience managing data pipelines and integrations via Hightouch or similar ETL tools
  • Strong UTM governance and tracking QA across multi-channel paid campaigns
  • Track record operating as an embedded technical partner to a Paid/growth team — driving requirements proactively rather than waiting on tickets
  • Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and communicate findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong attention to detail and a bias toward process and documentation
  • A sense of humor

Special Sauce* (nice to haves)

  • Owned a cost efficiency metric as part of your function
  • Part of the team or led the move to value-based bidding with measurable CAC or pipeline impact
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Proficiency with Marketo, including program setup, lead scoring, and ad platform integrations
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including lead routing, campaign attribution, and data hygiene
  • Experience with a CDP or data warehouse tool (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery)
  • Familiarity with SQL for data QA and ad-hoc reporting
  • Experience with TikTok or other emerging ad platform integrations beyond Meta and Google
  • Prior experience in an embedded ops role supporting a paid media team

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A
$124,000—$198,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
